# spaceman dream

Dream configurations of a space: list, create, update, start and runs (--space).

Aliases: `dreams`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman dream create`](#spaceman-dream-create) | Add a dream configuration |
| [`spaceman dream list`](#spaceman-dream-list) | A space's dream configurations |
| [`spaceman dream runs`](#spaceman-dream-runs) | Recent dreams of a configuration |
| [`spaceman dream start`](#spaceman-dream-start) | Dream now |
| [`spaceman dream update`](#spaceman-dream-update) | Edit a dream configuration (ID or slug; only the flags given change) |

## spaceman dream create

Add a dream configuration.

```sh
spaceman dream create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `create-dream` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman dream create --space payments nightly --name Nightly --role dreamer --interval-hours 24 --memory-role worker
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--include-own` | bool |  | include its own earlier dreams |
| `--instructions` | string |  | instructions |
| `--instructions-file` | string |  | read --instructions from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--interval-hours` | integer |  | hours between dreams, 0-720 (0: only manually) |
| `--max-bytes` | integer |  | most bytes changed |
| `--max-files` | integer |  | most files changed, 1-200 |
| `--max-minutes` | integer |  | longest dream, 5-240 |
| `--max-tokens` | integer |  | token budget |
| `--memory-role` | string, repeatable |  | role whose memory it reads (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--name` | string |  | name (required) |
| `--role` | string |  | space role that dreams (required) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--transcript-role` | string, repeatable |  | role whose transcripts it reads (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |

## spaceman dream update

Edit a dream configuration (ID or slug; only the flags given change).

```sh
spaceman dream update <dream> [flags]
```

API: `list-dreams`, `update-dream` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--include-own` | bool |  | include its own earlier dreams |
| `--instructions` | string |  | instructions |
| `--instructions-file` | string |  | read --instructions from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--interval-hours` | integer |  | hours between dreams, 0-720 (0: only manually) |
| `--max-bytes` | integer |  | most bytes changed |
| `--max-files` | integer |  | most files changed, 1-200 |
| `--max-minutes` | integer |  | longest dream, 5-240 |
| `--max-tokens` | integer |  | token budget |
| `--memory-role` | string, repeatable |  | role whose memory it reads (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--name` | string |  | name (required) |
| `--role` | string |  | space role that dreams (required) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--transcript-role` | string, repeatable |  | role whose transcripts it reads (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
